items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know his brother, Louie Keppert, in New Orleans. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that so?

ctx.x: I don't know. I've never... I've never... I never see her, never hear anything more of her since she's passing.
I know his brother, Louie Keppert, in New Orleans.
